purpose: One fixed small development mechanism diagnostic; retain unrestricted all-patch B1 as default
subject_check_reason: Use the existing source-only U2NETP region with the same unrestricted matching as B1; do not confound background restriction with radius2 correspondence
selection: Read only pair_id,source_group and the two cached winner columns; take up to6 disagreement source groups and4 agreement groups, disjoint sources, deterministic sha256 ranking and hidden display order
display: Original/instruction plus randomly swapped X/Y; hide expert labels, numeric scores, method winners and selection category from reviewer
blinding_limit: Repeated development89; reviewer knows prior aggregate results and some old examples. Display blinding is not independent confirmation or human annotation.
next_gate: Only if blinded image/instruction review supports an unintended subject-damage/background-similarity pattern: freeze one lightweight trigger before exposing per-pair scores/labels; otherwise stop
stop_rule: One rule and one evaluation on this fixed batch only; if rescue-minus-new-error<=0 or no usable scene, archive and stop; no threshold tuning or method expansion
confirmation_scope: No access to reserved20groups37pairs or their metadata/images/labels
